331934b0: ;This line is setting the initial value of variable I and X to null, and performing checks before jumping to the label A. It checks if the string DV does not contain the letter 'R', if DV is null or empty, and if the value of D is less than or equal to 0. If any of these conditions are true, it jumps to the label A.
496a29ba: If the input contains a question mark or starts with an up-arrow, call the D subroutine and branch to the ^DIE17 label.
3bee9956: If the input is the at sign (@), call the D subroutine and branch to the Z^DIE2 label.

e4ac5018: If the input is a space, the data validation string (DV) contains 'd' but not 'P', and the user has a node at ^DISV(DUZ,"DIE",DLB), set X to the value in that node. If DV does not contain 'D' or 'S', write the value of X preceded by two spaces.
15cae0c1: If the X parameter is followed by a colon and text, write that text. Otherwise, write nothing and move to the new line.
4e8440f1: Loop through each semi-colon piece. If the X parameter is found in a piece, write that piece up to the X parameter. If the 'DIC("S")' utility is present, execute it.
50f4e697: Write any remaining text after the X parameter. Set the X parameter to the next semi-colon piece.
6b271e36: Re-execute ^DIC lookup if file/entry was found.
03dc75ec: If a future date (date greater than TODAY) is being entered and the field is not free text (numeric), kill field.
a8439a8e: For numeric fields w/fractional part: Remove leading/trailing 0's; if decimals were present but result is integer, convert to integer.
4ca4e8e6: ;Execute lazy data fetch/compute if DQ holds an entryref or code
ed5e8842: ;Store latest value for data element in temporary array DG(DW) if not null and in auxiliary ^DISV global if requested by the data validation string DV (contains 'd').
83d0cb3b: ;If the input variable DQ is in the array DB, branch to the label Z^DIE17.
db025c40: ;If the previous condition is not met, set the variable X to the string '?BAD'.
34157f78: ;Set DZ to the value of X, then call routine D and QQ^DIEQ, and go to the label B.

951e00a2: This line sets the execution context to resolve the values of the pieces of the FDA array. The variable D is set to the current field number (DIFLD), and the DQ array is loaded with DLB (field length), DV (specifier type), DU (globally unique ID), DW (word-processing properties), and the text of the field definition.

730d46cb: ;Checks if data element DE(DQ) exists. If not, it calls the O routine. If X is not '@', it goes to label RD. If DV does not contain 'R' and X is '@', it goes to label A. If X is '@', it sets X to Y and goes to label N.
0202f3aa: ;Set DG to the value of DV, Y to the value of DE(DQ), and X to the value of DU. If there is a value at DQ(DQ,2), execute the code stored in that location and then go to the label RP.
35ef2d44: ;Set X to the number associated with the file, and Y to the value of the field in the current entry. DG contains the data type of the field.
7d4c17db: ;If the field is a variable pointer, retrieve the corresponding information.
5fa025ad: ;If the data type is a computed expression, evaluate it and store the result in Y.
a1f7febb: ;If the DV variable is false, branch to label A. If DV is true and the DC variable is less than 2, branch to label A. Otherwise, go to the N^DIE17 routine.
0f90d404: If DV contains a lowercase 'i' or a '#', go to label RD.
1d100bed: Call routine DIE0, passing in variable DV as a parameter. If the resulting value is stored in X or if PR is true, go to label RD.
51b49a77: If neither of the previous conditions were met, quit the routine.
